synthesis: The candidate combines zero-indexed reconstruction of the prime-power density with the failure of a semiclassical periodic-orbit interpretation due to missing repetition structure and orbit-dependent amplitudes.
source_support: Unit openalex_w2018932838_v2_u03 introduces the reverse Riemann formula, in which oscillatory terms indexed by zeta zeros reconstruct primes and prime powers, and warns that this formula is not automatically dynamical. Unit openalex_w2018932838_v2_u09 explicitly repeats that reconstruction and itself supplies the orbit-label identification, absence of repetition indices, absence of alpha-dependent amplitudes, incompatible-looking energy dependence, rejection of this formula as a dynamical trace formula, and the caveat that another prime trace formula may still exist.
nonparaphrase_operation: No qualifying cross-unit operation is established: the proposed obstruction and its limit are already available in full from openalex_w2018932838_v2_u09, while openalex_w2018932838_v2_u03 contributes introductory framing rather than a distinct premise needed to derive or refine the result.
limits: This rejection concerns eligibility as a synthesis requiring at least two distinct parent units; it does not dispute the source-supported failure of this particular dynamical reading and does not rule out every possible Hamiltonian or trace formula for primes.
quality_reason: Rejected as a reducible one-parent result. Although both parents are source-grounded and topically aligned, openalex_w2018932838_v2_u09 alone states every material element of the claim and proposed limit, so combining it with openalex_w2018932838_v2_u03 would be paraphrase-level aggregation rather than concrete cross-unit synthesis.
